questions.text: Which SPP document governs Regular Design Services?
questions.rationale: SPP Document 202 is the standard for Regular Design Services.
questions.explanation: Design Development is critical to project success and proper coordination. SPP 202 establishes standard fee allocations; negotiation is within broader structure. Design Development builds upon and substantially expands Schematic Design. Design Development represents substantial technical work on coordination and refinement from conceptual design to detailed documents, justifying 20% of fees under SPP 202 (SPP Doc 202). Design Development earns 20% due to substantial technical coordination work.

questions.text: In SPP 202, which phase comes before Schematic Design?
questions.rationale: Project Definition is the phase from which schematic design studies are derived.
questions.explanation: 15% is only Schematic Design; Design Development adds 20% more. 50% is the Contract Documents phase fee, not the cumulative after Design Development. 85% is the cumulative after Contract Documents. Schematic Design (15%) + Design Development (20%) = 35% cumulative fee upon completion of Design Development (SPP Doc 202). Cumulative fee after Design Development = 35% of total.

questions.text: Which item is a Project Definition duty under SPP 202?

options.text: Refining owner space requirements into an architectural program

questions.rationale: Project Definition includes reviewing and refining the owner's space requirements into an architectural program.
questions.explanation: Foreign architects have specific requirements; they cannot practice independently. BPO registration does not qualify foreign architects for architectural practice. International certification alone is insufficient without local permits. Foreign architects must secure a Temporary/Special Permit, a work permit from the Department of Labor and Employment, and must collaborate with a local registered and licensed architect (SPP Doc 202). Foreign architects need special permit, DOLE work permit, and local architect.

questions.text: Which phase prepares outline specifications and an updated SPPCC from approved schematic plans?
questions.rationale: Design Development prepares drawings, outline specifications, system diagrams, and an updated SPPCC.
questions.explanation: Partnerships and corporations are permitted forms of group practice. Foreign architects have special requirements; SPP 202 applies to all architects. BPO firms cannot provide architectural services unless PRC-registered. SPP 202 applies to group practice through partnerships or corporations provided full compliance with architectural legislation is maintained (SPP Doc 202). Group practice must maintain full compliance with architectural legislation.

questions.text: Which phase prepares detailed construction drawings and technical specifications?
questions.rationale: The Contract Document Phase prepares detailed drawings and technical specifications.
questions.explanation: BPO/KPO firms face restrictions on architectural service provision. Foreign collaboration does not remove the PRC registration requirement. BPO/KPO registration does not qualify firms for architectural work. Business Process Outsourcing and Knowledge Process Outsourcing firms registered in the Philippines cannot provide architectural services for Philippine projects unless they are PRC-registered architectural firms (SPP Doc 202). BPO/KPO firms need PRC architectural registration for Philippine projects.

questions.text: Which phase includes bid documents, bidder questions, and bid-result analysis?
questions.rationale: Bidding or Negotiation covers bid documents, bidder questions, and analysis of bid results.
questions.explanation: Schematic Design is the first fee-earning phase of SPP 202. Design Development is the second fee-earning phase. Construction Phase is SPP 202's final phase. Feasibility studies are pre-design services under SPP 201, not a phase within SPP 202's regular design framework (SPP Doc 202). Feasibility is a pre-design service; regular design begins with Schematic Design.

questions.text: Which source-safe statement describes the architect's site role in the Construction Phase?

options.text: The architect must provide continuous 8-hour supervision by default.
The architect makes periodic site visits unless full-time supervision is separately required.
The architect becomes the contractor's site superintendent.
The architect stops involvement after bid award.

questions.rationale: SPP 202 states periodic site visits; full-time 8-hour supervision is separately handled.
questions.explanation: Schematic Design earns 15%, the first but not largest payment. Design Development earns 20%, less than Contract Documents. Construction Administration earns 10%, the second-smallest allocation. Contract Documents represents the largest single phase payment at 50% of total design fees, reflecting the substantial technical work and responsibility for construction documents (SPP Doc 202). Contract Documents phase earns the largest single payment at 50%.

questions.text: Under UAP Document 401-402, completion of Contract Documents increases total payments to what cumulative milestone?
questions.rationale: The payment source increases total payments to 85% upon completion of Contract Documents.

questions.text: Why should a question about SPP 202 fee timing avoid saying bidding assistance has a standalone 5% fee?

options.text: The source supports payment milestones, not that standalone bidding split.
Bidding is not part of regular design services.
All fees are prohibited under SPP 202.
The architect is paid only after construction turnover.

questions.rationale: The checked payment source supports cumulative milestones and the remaining-fee breakdown, not a separate bidding-assistance percentage.

questions.text: For Philippine projects, what does SPP 202 say about BPO or KPO firms that are not PRC-registered architectural firms?

options.text: They may provide architectural services freely.
They are not authorized to provide architectural services for projects on Philippine soil.
They replace the local RLA requirement.
They may sign and seal architectural documents.

questions.rationale: SPP 202 says such BPO/KPO firms are not authorized for Philippine-soil architectural services unless PRC-registered as architectural firms.
